versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei抖音情报.

- Provides keyword search, creator content fetching, video comment analysis, and real-time hot trends for Douyin public data.
- Outputs up to 10,000 structured JSON results per request, suitable for content planning, competitor analysis, and public opinion monitoring.
- Supports intent recognition for implicit and explicit requests, with rules to handle varied user input.
- Requires configuration of a GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN and enforces strict error messaging and security standards.
- Not applicable for video editing, downloads, or private/other platform/internal data needs.
